entities.name: Xyris, the Writhing Storm
entities.description: A legendary giant flying snake leviathan of Ikoria that raids Skysail for human prey.

entities.name: Skysail
entities.description: A nomadic airship city raided by Xyris.

events.summary: Xyris regularly raids Skysail and overcomes each new defense.
events.quote: regularly raiding the nomadic airship city of Skysail for snacks

relations.note: Raids the city; its soldiers try to fight back.
relations.quote: Skysail’s soldiers work constantly on new ways to fight back
